name: route-topics
description: What kind of work a user message asks of the assistant, for model routing (specs/015). Eight topics; the app maps each to a model tier (app/core/routing_policy.py LABEL_TIERS). The labels describe the KIND OF WORK, not how hard the message is: a short message can be high_stakes and a long one can be lookup. The examples are authored for this repository's domains (support, operations, sales, internal policy), reviewed by a person before they are trusted, and kept disjoint from evals/datasets/route-topics.

smalltalk: Good morning, how are you today?
Who are you and what can you do?
You're awesome, thank you so much.
